title: Extracorporeal Photopheresis

criteria.text: Palliative treatment of skin manifestations of CTCL that has not responded to other therapy
criteria.span: Palliative treatment of skin manifestations of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma that has not responded to other therapy.

criteria.text: Acute cardiac allograft rejection refractory to standard immunosuppressive drug treatment

notes: The BOS-after-lung-transplant CED indication required an approved study by April 30, 2014, and says the NCD would otherwise expire for BOS; its current status cannot be read from the text, so no case tests BOS.
